description: User profile management endpoint. Displays and allows modification of user information including name, email, loan amount, term, and monthly payment. VULNERABLE TO IDOR ATTACKS via user_id parameter.
notes: CRITICAL VULNERABILITY: /profile?user_id=X allows accessing other users' profiles without authorization. Tested user_id 1-10 and all are accessible. Form fields are editable via POST. Allows viewing/modifying loan information for any user ID. No authorization checks present.
